description: This is a Java unit test class for the class 'PolicyCreated' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains test methods to verify immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and input validation for the PolicyCreated event class.

classes.name: PolicyCreatedTest
classes.description: A final class containing JUnit test cases for the 'PolicyCreated' event class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and input validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PolicyCreated class is immutable and that its associated Policy class is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of PolicyCreated behave correctly.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicy
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null Policy raises a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Policy with null ID throws a PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null Ditto headers when creating a PolicyCreated instance raises a NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output when called on a valid PolicyCreated instance.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutRevision
methods.description: Checks JSON serialization when the revision field is omitted.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a PolicyCreated instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: parsePolicyCreatedEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a PolicyCreated event can be correctly parsed from JSON using the GlobalEventRegistry.
